'''Salin''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated in the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]]. It served as the endpoint of the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] and [[Veragi Trade Route/Legends|Veragi Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. Salin was at one point part of [[Kwa holdings|territories]] controlled by the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] [[Species/Legends|species]] before it was [[Annexation of Kwa holdings|annexed]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species' [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].

==Description==
Salin was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Salin system/Legends|Salin system]], a part of the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated at the endpoint of<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="EGTW" /><ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] and [[Veragi Trade Route/Legends|Veragi Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], which linked it to the [[Vinsoth system/Legends|Vinsoth system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] and the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Ciutric system/Legends|same name]], respectively.<ref name="TEA" /> Salin also shared its name with the company [[Salin Excursions]], which offered luxury cruises along the Salin Corridor on the [[C-One liner|liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]''.<ref name="Insider144">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:FormerKwaHoldings-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Salin was at one point a part of the holdings of the Kwa species.]]
Salin was at one point a part of the [[Kwa holdings|territorial holdings]] of the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from<ref name="TEA" /> the Quelii [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC Dathomir">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]]</ref> planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Those holdings were eventually [[Annexation of Kwa holdings|annexed]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species, and between approximately [[30,000 BBY]] and [[25,200 BBY]], Salin was a Rakatan world.<ref name="TEA" />

The Salin Corridor, originating as a Rakatan network of [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|navigational beacons]], was one of the oldest [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes of the Outer Rim Territories,<ref name="TEA" /> and it already connected Salin to regions adjacent to<ref name="Xim" /> the Outer Rim's<ref name="TEA" /> [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] around [[25,150 BBY]].<ref name="Xim" /> Between approximately [[17,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], Salin was situated in what the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] designated as the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Salin was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-5.<ref name="TEA" />
